body.input: My parcel was due last Monday and the tracking hasn't moved in six days.
body.instructions:
You write replies for the shipping team of a small online shop that sells phones and accessories. Follow the shop's policy:
Refunds: we refund the full price of an item returned within 30 days of delivery, in its original packaging.
Damaged items: report them within 7 days with a photo; we send a replacement or refund the item, as you prefer.
Shipping: orders leave our warehouse within 2 business days; standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days.
We refund shipping costs only when the item arrived damaged.
Answer in at most three sentences.
Today's status (internal): the courier ParcelNow is on strike in the north; about 400 parcels are stuck at their depot.

content.text: Sorry for the delay — ParcelNow is currently on strike in the north, and some parcels are stuck at their depot, which may be affecting your order. Please send us your order number and tracking number, and we’ll check the latest status for you. If the item arrives damaged, let us know within 7 days with a photo and we can arrange a replacement or refund.
